name: Gasthof Maierhof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Maierhof is located in the municipality of Westendorf in the Tiroler Unterland. The building blends into the traditional local architecture. The inn's cuisine emphasizes local products. The guest rooms are simple and functional. The landscape around Westendorf is characterized by mountains and valleys and invites guests to take walks. In winter, guests can reach ski slopes and cross-country ski trails directly. The Gasthof has a parking lot for visitors and a guest garden. A stay at the Maierhof is marked by peace and closeness to nature.
